annotations.title: LLM Inference Cost and Gross Margin Calculator

description: Estimates monthly LLM spend, cost per user and per request, prompt-cache savings and gross margin for a usage profile on one of 8 models, compares all 8 models, and prices an 80/20 hybrid of DeepSeek and Claude 3.7 Sonnet. Same math and the same fixed price table as https://modevc.com/tools/llm-inference-calculator. The prices are that page's illustrative table, not a live price feed.
